name: Mael de Laval
original_name: マエル・ド・ラヴァル
source:
"It's been a hundred years. Looks like someone interesting has finally shown up."

One of the five nobles governing the Berezinsky domain, and a vampire descended from the bloodline of Gilles de Rais. Although he looks young, he is the oldest among the five and acts as an older brother figure to the other nobles.

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/WitchB_otomate/status/2014261763253125168/]Twitter[/url]]
